01Why now

Why this course, and why now

AI makes content cheap, which makes judgement valuable. This course covers the full marketing chain, from a clear offer to a measured funnel, and shows where AI saves hours and where a person must still decide.

04The lab

A 30-day campaign

Plan and prepare a 30-day campaign for a real or practice business. One project, built in steps after each lesson. Each step has instructions, a finished example, a health check, and saves on your device.

The steps

  1. Define audience, offer and goal
  2. Write the brand voice rules
  3. Produce the content set with AI
  4. Set up the funnel and automation
  5. Plan the measurement
  6. Review the content for accuracy and write the schedule

What the health check looks for

  • The goal has a number and a date
  • Every claim in the content has been checked
  • The funnel has one clear next step per stage

05How you learn

The same method as every Intellica course

See it done

Every lesson starts with a finished example, so you know what good looks like.

Do it yourself

Early steps are mostly filled in. Later steps give you a template, then a blank page.

Check your work

Questions bring back what you learned on a schedule, and a health check tells you if your lab work holds up.

Stay current

Courses are built from current research, with sources you can open, and revised when the evidence changes.

The method follows published research on retrieval practice, worked examples and spaced review. Read the evidence and sources.
